title: Merchant Side | Text Message | To Remove the amount and Make it the same as the email notification
summary: **The Problem:** SMS order notifications sent to customers displayed raw payment amounts that did not match the formatting or wording of the platform's email notifications. **Why It Mattered:** Inconsistent messaging between SMS and email confused shoppers about their order totals and undermined trust in automated store alerts. **How It Was Fixed:** The SMS notification template was updated to remove the mismatched amount field and align its copy and structure with the email notification standard.

title: Merchant Side | Store Location | Arrange in Alphabetical Order and Update Store Logo
summary: **The Problem:** Store locations in the merchant dashboard appeared in an arbitrary order, and store cards lacked individual branch logos. **Why It Mattered:** Merchants managing multiple branches struggled to locate specific stores quickly, and customer-facing location selectors looked generic. **How It Was Fixed:** Store locations were sorted alphabetically across the dashboard and storefront, and support for uploading and displaying per-location store logos was added.

title: Merchant Side | Max Ai |  Branding Tools (Change Name, Slogan, Subdomain) to Shared
summary: **The Problem:** Branding tools for updating a store's name, slogan, and subdomain were isolated inside a single onboarding flow rather than shared across the AI assistant. **Why It Was Fixed:** Duplicated or isolated tools meant merchants could not seamlessly update their store identity from other AI chat workflows. **How It Was Fixed:** The branding tools were refactored into a shared tool library so every AI assistant channel can reliably update store names, slogans, and subdomains.

title: Merchant Side | Max AI: Blog | Max Copywriter Enhancements
summary: **The Problem:** The AI blog copywriter produced inconsistent article formatting and lacked structured research context when drafting posts for merchants. **Why It Was Fixed:** Merchants rely on the blog tool to publish SEO-friendly store content quickly without heavy manual editing. **How It Was Fixed:** Prompt templates were refined and paired with an automated web research step so the copywriter generates clearer, better-structured blog drafts.

title: Merchant Side | Front - End Standardization
summary: **The Problem:** Prosperna's merchant dashboard relied on legacy Bootstrap styling with inconsistent spacing, colors, and component behavior across dozens of settings and management pages. **Why It Was Fixed:** Maintaining legacy styles slowed down feature development and created an uneven visual experience for merchants. **How It Was Fixed:** The dashboard was systematically standardized onto a unified Tailwind CSS component library across all core merchant modules.

title: Merchant Side | Orders | Empty State Text Changes [Contacts, Orders, Inventory, Categories, Add-ons, Product Reviews, Discounts & Blogs]
summary: **The Problem:** Empty-state screens across Contacts, Orders, Inventory, Categories, Add-ons, Product Reviews, Discounts, and Blogs displayed outdated or generic placeholder copy. **Why It Was Fixed:** New merchants opening empty sections needed clear, encouraging guidance on what each module does and how to get started. **How It Was Fixed:** Empty-state text across all eight merchant modules was rewritten to be clear, consistent, and action-oriented.

title: Merchant Side | Settings | Small Text Fixes to Order Management and Product Review Settings Tab
summary: **The Problem:** Minor copy inconsistencies and unclear labels appeared in the Order Management and Product Review Settings tabs. **Why It Was Fixed:** Clear settings labels prevent merchants from misconfiguring order workflows or customer review moderation. **How It Was Fixed:** Text labels and helper descriptions in both settings tabs were refined for clarity and consistency.

title: Merchant Side | Redesign Empty State Icons
summary: **The Problem:** Empty-state illustrations across the merchant dashboard used inconsistent legacy artwork that did not match the updated visual language. **Why It Was Fixed:** Cohesive visual design makes the dashboard feel modern, approachable, and easier to scan. **How It Was Fixed:** Minimalist, unified empty-state icons were designed and rolled out across the merchant interface.

title: Website Restore | Fruitgals | https://fruitgals.prosperna.com
summary: **The Problem:** Following a database ransomware incident, the Fruitgals online storefront suffered broken product images, missing banners, and corrupted catalog links. **Why It Was Fixed:** The live merchant store could not display products properly to shoppers, directly impacting sales. **How It Was Fixed:** Corrupted media references were audited, clean assets were restored, and the storefront's visual catalog was brought back online.

title: Website Restore | Firehouse Pizza
summary: **The Problem:** The Firehouse Pizza storefront experienced broken imagery and layout disruptions after the platform-wide storage incident. **Why It Was Fixed:** Restoring accurate menu visuals and hero banners was critical to keeping the merchant's online ordering experience functional. **How It Was Fixed:** Affected media records were reconstructed and re-linked so the storefront rendered cleanly again.

title: Website Restore | Balipura
summary: **The Problem:** Balipura's live storefront lost hero banners, category thumbnails, and product catalog imagery. **Why It Was Fixed:** Shoppers could not browse collections or view product photos, halting normal storefront operations. **How It Was Fixed:** All missing storefront assets were recovered and reconnected to their respective product and category records.

title: Merchant Side | Images from S3 Bucket to Repository Based
summary: **The Problem:** Core platform images—such as marketplace badges, payment gateway icons, and theme previews—were hosted on external AWS S3 buckets, making them vulnerable to external storage disruptions. **Why It Was Fixed:** Moving essential UI assets into version-controlled repository storage eliminates external points of failure and speeds up deployments. **How It Was Fixed:** Static images across Marketplace, Payment Settings, and Themes were migrated from AWS S3 into repository-backed assets.

title: Website Revision | Tintin Bazaar
summary: **The Problem:** The Tintin Bazaar storefront required visual and layout revisions to address display issues and align with the merchant's branding. **Why It Was Fixed:** Ensuring clean presentation across desktop and mobile devices improves shopper trust and conversion. **How It Was Fixed:** Requested layout adjustments, banner updates, and visual fixes were applied and verified on the live storefront.

title: Customer Side | Product Page | Make product categories list scrollable to show all items
summary: **The Problem:** On storefronts with large product catalogs, the category navigation list was cut off and could not be scrolled. **Why It Was Fixed:** Shoppers were unable to reach categories further down the list, limiting product discovery. **How It Was Fixed:** The category menu container was updated to be viewport-aware and scrollable so every category remains accessible.

title: Migration | Legacy Page Builder to Max AI | Croia
summary: **The Problem:** Croia's storefront was still running on Prosperna's legacy page builder, which lacked modern layout flexibility and AI-assisted editing. **Why It Was Fixed:** Migrating to Max AI unlocks faster page updates, responsive layouts, and modern storefront components. **How It Was Fixed:** The entire Croia storefront was rebuilt and migrated from the legacy page builder into Max AI.

title: Merchant Side | Store Location | Cannot upload a store logo per location — cards show auto-generated initials only
summary: **The Problem:** Merchants could not upload a custom logo per store location; cards only displayed auto-generated initials. **Why It Was Fixed:** Multi-branch businesses needed distinct branch imagery so customers and staff could easily tell locations apart. **How It Was Fixed:** A per-location logo upload flow was added to the dashboard and wired into the location cards.

title: Website Restore | Kaye & Ikay's Online Health & Beauty Shop
summary: **The Problem:** Kaye & Ikay's Online Health & Beauty Shop lost product and banner imagery during the storage incident. **Why It Was Fixed:** Restoring the storefront's visual catalog was essential for the merchant to resume normal online sales. **How It Was Fixed:** Missing media assets were recovered and re-linked across the storefront.

title: Website Revision | Fixing Balipura Website Errors
summary: **The Problem:** Balipura's storefront exhibited post-recovery display errors and broken layout elements. **Why It Was Fixed:** Resolving remaining visual bugs ensured a smooth, reliable shopping experience for customers. **How It Was Fixed:** Remaining page errors and asset references were diagnosed and fixed.

title: Migration | Legacy Page Builder to Max AI | Ocean of Youth
summary: **The Problem:** Ocean of Youth's storefront was built on the legacy page builder, limiting design updates and mobile responsiveness. **Why It Was Fixed:** Moving to Max AI provides a modern, maintainable storefront with better performance. **How It Was Fixed:** All pages and sections were migrated from the legacy page builder to Max AI.

title: Website Restore | GoNegosyo
summary: **The Problem:** The GoNegosyo storefront suffered missing images and broken page sections following the storage incident. **Why It Was Fixed:** As a high-visibility partner storefront, restoring full visual integrity was a top priority. **How It Was Fixed:** Storefront media and page configurations were restored and verified end-to-end.
